name: Playa Kitchen at Torrey Pines Science Center
notes: First-party BentoBox site, full breakfast/lunch cafe menu (hours 9am-2pm per lajolla.ca). Several drinks are printed as a small/large range (e.g. "$4 - $4.50"); recorded the low end and noted 'size range, low end recorded' in each such dish's description is omitted, applies to: Brewed Coffee, Cappuccino, Latte, Vanilla Latte, Brown Sugar Latte, Lavender Honey Latte, Mocha Hot Chocolate, Vanilla Chai Latte, Spiced Chai, Dirty Chai, Matcha Latte, Dirty Matcha, Lavender Matcha, Hot Tea. Salad/bowl protein add-ons (chicken +$8, salmon +$12, shrimp +$10) and a $0.50 coffee flavor add-on are general modifiers printed once for the section and were not filed as separate dish rows.
